intervention.allowed_change: Construct the fixed 7/8/6 parent graphs from repeated copies of the pinned runtime's raw capture body: stable step-specific ForwardBatch buffers, out-of-graph attention setup, in-graph attention metadata initialization, raw model.forward, finite greedy argmax, and the immediately dependent next-step state.
forbidden: runner.graphs[32].replay or any other instantiated child CUDAGraph replay
repair or replay of the three consumed child-graph arms
block-length, concurrency, or graph-memory geometry sweep
model, checkpoint, dtype, ring, cache, sampler, workload, or comparator change
host synchronization between forwards inside a block
intervention.memory_rule: Record graph-pool and free-memory bytes before and after warmup and instantiation. If the exact c32 7/8/6 graphs cannot instantiate in retained H200 memory, emit a typed topology blocker without changing batch, block geometry, model state, checkpoint, or runtime.
official_capture_sequence: slice stable c32 input_ids, req_pool_indices, seq_lens, out_cache_loc, and positions from the runtime buffer registry
construct one step-specific ForwardBatch with the exact capture forward mode and padding state
set the exact DP buffer length and call raw model.forward(input_ids, positions, forward_batch)
apply finite temperature-zero greedy argmax into the next step's stable input buffer
run the stock warmup cleanup hooks and share the pinned runtime graph pool
intervention.topology: One raw direct-model parent graph per fixed 7/8/6 block; no pre-instantiated child graph and no host-owned metadata mutation between forwards.

measurement_gate.component: Run one real-state 32x22 component against a fresh untimed stock oracle. Require 704/704 exact finite token transitions, 32/32 exact rows, byte-exact KV writes, exact positions and request ownership, and exactly 3 rather than 21 host result boundaries.
measurement_gate.endpoint: Run exactly one unchanged c32 endpoint only after the complete component passes and its measured conservative bound is credibly positive; require 32/32 finite rows, 358 tokens per row, and exact 17120 cached plus 117728 fresh prompt-token accounting.
measurement_gate.timing: Report graph instantiation memory, device events, graph launches, host synchronizations, block-result latency, and the conservative whole-request service-time bound.
